name: Grant to Films - Regional Dialects of Uttarakhand
briefDescription: Under this scheme, grants and subsidies are provided to filmmakers and producers to cover expenses incurred during film production.
descriptionMd: Under this scheme, grants and subsidies are provided to filmmakers and producers to cover expenses incurred during film production. Additional incentives are available for children’s films. OTT-based projects are also eligible under specific conditions, promoting diverse cinematic content within Uttarakhand.
benefitsMd:
- Grants and subsidies provided to cover film production expenses.
- Additional incentives available for children's films.
- OTT-based projects are eligible under specific conditions.
- Support for films promoting regional dialects of Uttarakhand.
eligibilityMd:
- Filmmakers and producers are eligible.
- Projects incurring film production expenses are eligible.
- Children's films are eligible for additional incentives.
- OTT-based projects are eligible under specific conditions.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
